sentences: The loop checks a[i], and 1 is not 9, so it moves on to the next one.
Since a[0] is 1, the else branch just means keep searching forward.
The first index fails the check, so control continues and finds 9 at index 1.
When the if condition is false for a[0], nothing stops the loop from going ahead.
At i equals 0 the value is not 9, so the next index gets checked and returns 1.
